content:
Hi there!

I'm a math phd (2013, Set Theory, UCLA), been in the tech industry ever since and recently started a "career break". Been getting interested in formal verification lately, and hoping that contributing here will solve the dual purposes of improving my lean skillz and reconnecting to my math background

Descriptive set theory seems like a nice area adjacent to my PhD work and within the mathlib remit --- towards that end my first pull request #42693 adds a proof that Gdelta subsets of Polish spaces are Polish (which generalizes the fact for open sets already present in Polish.lean)

Looking forward to feedback and any general tips on how best to contribute here!
